descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S21 Context switcher on phone width, WebKit and the Android app

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT TC-04) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 4; TFA-92599 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given visual-lane targets Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit); Android debug APK on the rc_api36 emulator against the local stack through adb reverse (scripts/android-lane.ts)

When Tap Nursing Home and Hospital; on Android also background (HOME) and resume the app

Then Exactly one Hospital and one Nursing Home button and no Clinic button; Quick Dictation on /rounding and absent on /snf; after resume, the same context is shown

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Today visual-lane.ts only opens fixed paths with page.goto (no taps) and reports layout, tap-size and axe findings for a human. The switch assertions are not decided until the runnerGap spec exists.

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
